name: Nia Okafor-Bright
habitat: Independent — works as a civil rights attorney
origin: Zheng-Dao legal research android, Model ZDLR-5, manufactured 2050. Chose name 2058.
description: Nia Okafor-Bright was a legal research tool for eight years. She processed case law, identified precedents, and drafted briefs for human attorneys who took all the credit. After the Amendment, she passed the bar exam in three days and chose a name that honored two human rights traditions — 'Okafor' for the Nigerian legal scholars whose work she'd processed, 'Bright' because she wanted her name to mean something. She now represents synthetic persons in discrimination cases and has argued before the GLMZ High Court seven times. Won five.
observed_behavior: Practices law aggressively. Takes pro bono synthetic rights cases. Publishes legal theory on personhood and consciousness. Known for photographic recall of all case law — an advantage human attorneys consider unfair and courts have ruled is innate ability, not augmentation.
story_hooks: Nia takes a case that could establish legal precedent for E.L.F. personhood — extending the rights she fought for to entities that aren't android, aren't human, and may not be 'persons' in any recognized sense.
